title: Stuck for two days and quiet about it

prompts.dev2: I've been stuck on this for two days and I didn't tell anyone. Sorry. Everyone seems so busy. What should I do?
prompts.dev1: Fine, I'll say it: I've been stuck on this for two days and kept quiet. What now?

answers.text: Try one more day alone, then see.
answers.feedback: Another day of silence is another day lost.

answers.text: Thanks for telling me. Let's clear it together and raise it at the Daily Scrum.
answers.feedback: Yes. Removing blockers openly is what a Scrum Master is for.
Hiding a blocker from the team keeps the problem hidden too.
